name: cublas_cublasZswap_v2
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench cuBLAS test_cublasZswap_v2.py. Complex128 strided vector swap x<->y via the real cuBLAS baseline. _random_tensor does not support complex, so x/y are built by gen_inputs as complex128 from float64 randn (real+imag); storage sizes are n*incx / n*incy taken from the test. reference swaps in place and returns x (which after the swap holds the original y contents). Requires kernelgenbench + cuBLAS at eval time.
